description: Provider comparison (CONTEXT.md, Model comparison method): the deployed provider (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5, medium, the reference) against Azure OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini at medium (Data Zone Standard, swedencentral, token auth through az login), three live uncached runs each, retry included, same prompt, schemas and golden set. Not a Baseline: eval/thresholds.yaml is unchanged and no threshold is moved by this file.

failures.detail: RM_REFEREE may not remove "- Role made redundant during the firm's merger; left on good terms with a reference available."
RM_REFEREE may not remove "with a reference available."
RM_REFEREE may not remove "a reference available."
RM_REFEREE may not remove "with a reference available."
structural leaves below 100% precision or recall

notes: The sides differ in provider and model; effort is the label medium on both, but each provider's effort scale is its own, so equal labels do not mean equal compute. Read each side as one configuration.

Three new Sonnet runs, retry included, not the Phase 1.5 runs: those (eval/model-comparison-2026-10-19.json) are on prompt 1.3.0 with no retry and carry no retry versions, so the aggregator could not verify them as the same configuration. Prompt 1.3.0 (f326caf4f478e95d), schema 1.0.0 (3ee02723787bc1ee), retry prompt 1dc17179dfa3e638 and additions schema 6f2720458f33bf3e on all six runs; 48 documents and 48 live first attempts each, cache never read (the aggregator refuses a run with cache hits).

The Azure model is gpt-5.4-mini (2026-03-17, DataZoneStandard, 200K TPM, $0.825 in and $4.95 out per million tokens), not gpt-5.4. cvr_sub had 0 quota for gpt-5.4 in every EU region (2026-10-24), and a quota request for gpt-5.6-terra was refused 2026-10-29 (Sweden Central has no capacity to expand). The comparison therefore says nothing about the stronger Azure models. Azure runs used --concurrency 2 because Azure counts max_completion_tokens (32000) against TPM up front.

Sonnet passed every gate in all three runs. Every hard-gate count was zero (added, dropped, wrongful removals, provenance, PII, images, ordering, punctuation, label failures, errors); structural 100/100; tunable precision 99.65 and recall 99.73 in every run (threshold 98); appendix 0.67% (threshold 2). Cost $1.7109 to $1.7119 a run, wall time 137.5 to 139.6 s. 9 retries fired in each run (c09 and c11), placing 25 characters, at about $0.118. The three runs are nearly identical.

gpt-5.4-mini failed the gate in all three runs, on the hard removal_precision gate and on the tunable placement threshold. Added, dropped, provenance, PII, image, ordering, punctuation, labelling-failure and error counts were zero in every run, so it never invented, lost or leaked text; the appendix rate was 0.57 to 0.64%, inside its 2% threshold.

Hard gate, removal_precision: 7, 6 and 9 wrongful removals (runs 1 to 3). (1) c07, RM_PERSONAL removes the content text 'EU citizen': 3 Layouts in run 1 (header-footer, single-column, text-box), 2 in run 2 (header-footer, two-column), all 4 in run 3. (2) c04, RM_REFEREE removes the tail of a content line ending 'reference available' (in run 1 the whole bullet in header-footer): 4 Layouts in each run. (3) run 3 only: c10 two-column, RM_PERSONAL removes 'India'. Haiku 5.5 failed in the same two places in Phase 1.5 (c04 RM_REFEREE, c07 'EU citizen').
Hard gate, structural placement: run 2 only, c08 text-box, structural precision and recall 99.63% (4 of 1072 leaves) against the 100% requirement. Runs 1 and 3 were 100/100.

Threshold, tunable placement: precision 43.89, 43.94, 44.42 and recall 43.97, 44.06, 44.50 against the 98% minimum, with all 12 candidates named in every run. By Layout (precision, three runs): single-column 98.59 to 99.65 (passes alone); text-box 47.87 to 48.06; header-footer 14.13 to 16.67; two-column 14.08 to 14.54. The collapse is in the three Layouts other than single-column. This record does not diagnose why (the report holds counts, not a per-leaf diff); the appendix rate is small, so the misses are placement choices rather than unplaced text.

Retries on gpt-5.4-mini: 14, 16 and 13 fired (Sonnet 9), placing 369, 480 and 278 characters (Sonnet 25), at $0.0688, $0.0763 and $0.0582 a run (Sonnet about $0.118). A retry is additions-only for unplaced text (ADR-0012), so it cannot correct a leaf the first attempt placed in the wrong field.

Cost and time: gpt-5.4-mini $1.0293 to $1.05 a run ($3.1285 for three) against Sonnet $1.7109 to $1.7119 ($5.1346), about 39% less per run; wall time 418.7 to 435.7 s against 137.5 to 139.6 s, about three times longer (Azure at concurrency 2, Sonnet at 4). Tokens: Azure 209,468 to 221,031 in and 171,107 to 177,042 out; Sonnet 328,380 to 328,423 in and 105,413 to 105,506 out (different tokenisers; reasoning tokens count as output). Prices from cvr.label.pricing, Azure checked 2026-10-24.
The Azure runs authenticated through the default Azure credential, which on the maintainer's machine resolves to az login, the same chain the managed identity uses in Container Apps (ADR-0014).

verdict.rule: Spec: any hard-gate breach, wrongful removal, labelling failure or non-provider error in any run disqualifies a candidate; thresholds applied unchanged; above the gate the call is the maintainer's, on the side-by-side numbers.

gpt-5.4-mini-medium.reasoning: Failed the hard removal_precision gate in all three runs (6 to 9 wrongful removals: c04 RM_REFEREE and c07 RM_PERSONAL every run), the structural gate in run 2 (c08 text-box), and the tunable placement threshold in all three (precision 43.89 to 44.42, recall 43.97 to 44.50 against 98; single-column alone passes). About 39% cheaper a run and about three times slower; neither outweighs removed content lines and misplaced fields. Added, dropped, provenance, PII, image and ordering counts were zero, so the failures are of labelling quality, not of the content boundary.

sonnet-5-5-medium.reasoning: Passed every gate on every run, every hard-gate count zero, tunable 99.65/99.73, appendix 0.67%, about $1.71 and 138 s a run.

verdict.recommendation: Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium stays the deployed and gated provider. Azure OpenAI stays a supported second provider (ADR-0014), but gpt-5.4-mini does not pass the gate; gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.6-terra could not be compared (no quota). Ticket 21 is not needed.
